title: Jimmy Kimmel Live draws its biggest ever midterm election night audience
summary: The ABC show drew about 2.4 million viewers, up more than half on 2022.
body:
Jimmy Kimmel Live drew about 2.4 million viewers for its midterm election night show, the largest audience the programme has ever had for a midterm telecast, according to Nielsen figures reported by Variety.

The audience was up by more than half on the show's 2022 midterm episode, which drew about 1.56 million viewers.

Top of late night

ABC says the show has been the most-watched late-night programme in every week of the television season so far.

Sources: Variety, The Futon Critic.
